name: Cream Sauce
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Melt the butter and flour together and stir until they froth
Add the milk and stir constantly until it thickens and boils
If it must stand any time before serving, it should be closely covered and stirred occasionally to prevent a skin forming on the top
When a large quantity is made, 3/4 of the milk may be scalded and added after the first third is stirred in

source.originalInstructions:
1. Melt the butter and flour together and stir until they froth
2. Add the milk and stir constantly until it thickens and boils
3. Add the salt and pepper
4. If it must stand any time before serving, it should be closely covered and stirred occasionally to prevent a skin forming on the top
5. When a large quantity is made, 3/4 of the milk may be scalded and added after the first third is stirred in
